title: Standing on Three Legs: The Support Polygon, How Near the Centre of Mass Is to Its Edge, and the Shift of the Body That a Crawl Needs

questions.question: What makes a body statically stable?
options: Its centre of mass is lower than its hips
At least three feet are on the ground, wherever the centre of mass is
Its centre of mass, projected down, is inside the polygon of the feet on the ground
The forces on its feet are equal
questions.explanation: Three feet down are not enough on their own: the centre of mass, seen from above, has to be inside the triangle they make. How far inside is the margin.

questions.question: With the body centred and a foot lifted the margin was:
options: 0.078 m, the same as after a shift
0.031 m, since three feet still surround the centre
Negative: the centre was outside the triangle
0.000 m, on the diagonal
questions.explanation: With a foot lifted, the diagonal between two of the remaining feet passes exactly under the centre of a centred body. It is on an edge, with no room at all.

questions.question: After moving the centre of mass to the middle of the three feet the margin was:
options: 0.081 m, the same as the shift
0.150 m, the distance of the feet from the centre line
questions.explanation: Over the middle of the triangle the nearest edge was 0.078 m away, for a shift of up to 8.1 cm. The 0.031 m was a 5 cm shift forward with a hind foot lifted.

questions.question: A shift forward with a front foot lifted:
options: Goes toward the foot that is leaving and does not help
Gives the same margin as with a hind foot lifted
Gives the largest margin, since the weight goes over the front
Makes no difference, because the shift is along the body
questions.explanation: With a front foot going up, forward is toward the missing corner. The same shift that helped with a hind foot lifted now moves the centre out of the triangle.

questions.question: Why is zero margin not safe?
options: The legs' torque is at its highest there
A push, a bump or the swing of the leg itself tips it
The margin is only measured to a centimetre
Three legs cannot carry the weight for long
questions.explanation: Zero margin means the centre of mass is exactly over an edge, so any disturbance toward that edge starts the body tipping, and the lifted leg's own swing is one.

questions.question: What does the margin not say?
options: Which foot is lifted
Which edge of the triangle is nearest
Whether the centre of mass is inside or outside
Anything about acceleration or the swing of the lifted leg
questions.explanation: It is a static measure: a picture from above with nothing moving. A body that accelerates presses somewhere else (35-06), and a trot has no polygon at all (35-02).
